title: Build Analytics
subtitle: Monitor agent performance, token usage, and build metrics
serverSubtitle: Computed by the server from this project's runs, for the whole team

empty.noProject: Select a project to view analytics

compare.title: How you compare
compare.privacyLocal: Compared with your other projects on this computer, read from their folders. Nothing leaves your computer.
compare.privacyServer_one: Compared with the projects of your organization you can read, as medians only, never by name, and only for groups of {{count}} project or more. Nothing leaves the server.
compare.privacyServer_other: Compared with the projects of your organization you can read, as medians only, never by name, and only for groups of {{count}} projects or more. Nothing leaves the server.
compare.window_one: Medians per spec over the last {{days}} days ({{count}} spec), against the {{days}} days before ({{previous}}).
compare.window_other: Medians per spec over the last {{days}} days ({{count}} specs), against the {{days}} days before ({{previous}}).
compare.smallGroup_one: A group's median shows from {{count}} active project.
compare.smallGroup_other: A group's median shows from {{count}} active projects: below that, only its size.
compare.lowerIsBetter: Lower is better, except for the mutation score and the first-run CI pass rate, where higher is. A spec's build time runs from its first agent session to its last.
compare.noOtherProjects: None of your other projects built a spec in this period.
compare.topNote_one: Top 10% is the figure the best tenth of a group reach; it shows from {{count}} active project.
compare.topNote_other: Top 10% is the figure the best tenth of a group reach; it shows from {{count}} active projects with that figure.

report.title: How you compare: team report
report.error: Could not save the team report

kinds.title: By kind of work
kinds.none: No spec of this period has a kind recorded on its card.
kinds.note_one: Each cell: this project, then the median of the other projects for the same kind, from {{count}} project.
kinds.note_other: Each cell: this project, then the median of the other projects for the same kind, from {{count}} projects.

compare.qualitySources: The mutation score comes from the spec's mutation gate in QA, the first-run CI pass from the follow-through of its pull request: whether the CI passed on the pull request as it was opened, before any fix. A spec without them is not counted for them.
compare.moving: This project moved from {{from}} to {{to}} in the last {{days}} days: until that is older than {{days}} days, it is compared with projects of both.

pace.title: Your pace against your peers
pace.faster: {{metric}}: {{own}} for this project, {{group}} for the median of “{{groupName}}”. You are improving faster.
pace.slower: {{metric}}: {{own}} for this project, {{group}} for the median of “{{groupName}}”. Your peers are improving faster.
pace.same: {{metric}}: {{own}} for this project, {{group}} for the median of “{{groupName}}”. About the same pace.
